title: Inter: 10 press reports this week, only 1 held up
caption:
Inter in the Italian press this week: 10 reported items, 1 confirmed, 9 still open, none denied. Gazzetta dello Sport said Zieliński would stay with Poland, and Inter.it says he captained them. Lautaro on the bench in Bergamo today? Per Tuttosport and Corriere dello Sport — the club has not said. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
